definitions.explanation: A person who invests money in stocks, real estate, businesses, or other assets with the expectation of financial return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{投資家|とうしか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投資家|とうしか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: They raised funds from overseas investors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{投資家|とうしか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{買|か}い{時|どき}だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧し、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}した→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧。
examples.english: A famous investor said "now is the time to buy," and the market reacted.

notes:
{投資家|とうしか} is a general term for anyone who invests money in assets for financial return. A compound of ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (investment) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (person, specialist).

TYPES:
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{投資家|とうしか}: individual/retail investor
- ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧{投資家|とうしか}: institutional investor
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{投資家|とうしか}: foreign investor
- エンジェル{投資家|とうしか}: angel investor

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投資家|とうしか}⟦{心理|しんり}→心理：03332_shinri⟧: investor sentiment
- {投資家|とうしか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to recruit investors
- {投資家|とうしか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to raise funds from investors

USAGE:
The ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ suffix indicates a person engaged in a professional or serious pursuit. Compare: ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧ (politician), ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ (writer), ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (specialist).
